newsitem.title: USA: Struthers Industries names Shankar CEO.
newsitem.headline: Struthers Industries names Shankar CEO.

text.p: Struthers Industries Inc said its board has named C.P. Shankar as chief executive officer of Struthers and its subsidiary WINCOM Corp.
Shankar, 42, leaves a position at Hughes Network Systems' DirecPC where he was head of marketing and sales.

Struthers, through its acquisition of WINCOM Corp, is a telecommunications company which plans to provide advanced utility automation and data services using a wireless technology developed by WINCOM.

Struthers chairman Raoul Carroll in a statement said Shankar was recruited as CEO because he is "a proven industry leader with over 20 years of experience in the computer and telecommunications industries."

Shankar said he has been impressed with his new company's business model. WINCOM is the largest single holder in the United States of spectrum license rights for a type of wireless service it developed called IVDS. Shankar said those rights offer Struthers a "phenomenal opportunity to provide a range of compelling, high value-added services to both residential and business customers," in a statement.
